divergences: API: LEADERBOARD_POLICY and leaderboardFetch (AlienClaw-specific) are not exported; all other exports (FetchPolicy, ResolvedAddress, DEFAULT_PROTOCOLS, MAX_REDIRECTS, isBlockedHost, validateResolvedAddresses, hardenedFetch) are identical.

Block list: none. CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10 was already blocked in-tree, so no range was added; the 2026-11-26 NAT64 change was made in both modules. test/parity-in-tree.test.ts asserts an empty decision-divergence set against the in-tree module.

Non-behavioural: unused node:http and node:https imports removed; header comment rewritten (AlienClaw consumer list dropped; the in-tree claim that resolver-inconsistency attacks are impossible replaced by a statement that fetch() re-resolves DNS); one section comment reworded. All function bodies are verbatim.

Tests: ported ssrf-vectors fixes the in-tree '[::])' typo (it passed only via fail-closed parsing) and replaces four vacuous obfuscated-IPv4 assertions with real new URL() canonicalisation; the two expect(true) jail construction notes are not ported.

Tests: test/hardening.test.ts is the in-tree test/net/hardened-fetch-hardening.test.ts without its LEADERBOARD_POLICY / leaderboardFetch block; test/hardened-fetch.test.ts flips the NAT64 and body-read KNOWN GAPS into 'fixed gaps' and expects timeoutMs 0 to be an invalid policy.

2026-11-26 security fixes, applied identically to src/alienclaw/net/hardened-fetch.ts and the staged copy (findings from docs/salvage/SANDBOX-SECURITY-REVIEW.md): SR-05 FetchPolicy is validated before any I/O (timeoutMs integer 1..2147483647, maxBytes integer 0..268435456, maxRedirects integer 0..20 defaulting to MAX_REDIRECTS, protocols an array of strings, allowedHosts a Set; anything else throws TypeError 'Invalid FetchPolicy: ...'; this also fixes SR-11 timer overflow); SR-07 one AbortController deadline covers DNS, connect, headers and the full body read across all hops; SR-12 (NAT64 part) 64:ff9b::/96 is blocked when its embedded IPv4 is blocked, and 64:ff9b:1::/48 is blocked whole. 6to4, Teredo, fec0::/10 and DNS pinning (SR-04) remain open.

source_commit is still the original copy point. source_blob for src/hardened-fetch.ts and test/hardening.test.ts is the post-fix in-tree blob (git hash-object), which was not yet committed when this file was written.
